title: Continuity of the induced noise modulus
statement: Let $\eta(n)$ be a number in $[0,1]$ for each natural number $n$, and suppose $\eta(n)\to 0$ as $n\to\infty$. Define a function on $[0,1/2]$ by taking its value at $\delta>0$ to be $\eta(\lfloor1/\delta\rfloor)$, and its value at $\delta=0$ to be $0$. This function tends to $0$ as $\delta\to0$ through positive values in $[0,1/2]$.
hypotheses_covered: The parameter $\delta$ approaches $0$ within $[0,1/2]$ through positive values
